hintSingleElim: Knockout: lose once and you are out; the last team standing wins.
hintDoubleElim: Double elimination: a team must lose twice (winners and losers bracket) before it is out.
hintLeague: League: every team plays every other, ranked on points (3 for a win, 1 for a draw).
hintRoundRobin: Round robin: every team plays every other, ranked on points (3 for a win, 1 for a draw).
hintGeneric: Head-to-head bracket: teams are matched pair by pair until a winner is decided.
hintSplit: Each group below runs its own bracket at the same time. The top teams from each group go through to the next stage, so this is the shape to use for a group phase.
splitHelp: For a group phase: several groups play their own brackets at the same time, and the top teams from each go through. Leave this off for one straight bracket.
groupsFooter: Each group gets its own bracket, its own teams and its own room settings. Add teams to a group and generate its bracket from the event page once the event is saved.
nothingToConfigureBody: There are no Battle Royale groups, maps or lobby rooms for a Clash Squad stage. Just set the stage name, dates and how many teams qualify, then save.
nothingToConfigureBody2: Once the event is saved and teams have registered, open the event page and use the bracket card to generate the bracket (it seeds from the registered teams) and enter each match result.
roomHelp: Rounds, map, store, economy and the room ID players join with. You can also set this later from the bracket on the event page.
